notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). TypeScript guide for connecting to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with node-postgres (pg): password and Entra ID token auth, Client vs Pool, parameterized queries, transactions, typed queries, token-refreshing pool wrapper, error codes, connection strings, pool events and sizing.

Medium only because SKILL.md:19-20 tells the agent to `npm install pg @azure/identity` and `npm install -D @types/pg` (unpinned; pg is the community node-postgres package, @azure/identity is Microsoft's). Database connections, queries and token acquisition are TypeScript sample code for the user's application reading AZURE_POSTGRESQL_* environment variables; the agent is not told to connect to a database, read secrets, or run anything else.

Samples INSERT rows into users/orders tables when run against a real database. Password auth and a connection-string template with inline user:password are shown as alternatives to the recommended passwordless Entra ID path; SSL with rejectUnauthorized: true is enforced throughout.
